purpose: Test whether BA24's global block-interface parameter kappa is unnecessarily coarse by exposing individual surviving variables as factor-graph vertices and carrying only separator-local variable values rather than whole block-interface assignments.

do_not_claim: bounded-treewidth SAT dynamic programming is a new general mathematical discovery
arbitrary foreign CNF BA4 carrier transport
novelty_firewall.project_level_target: JANUS/TRUMP's sealed compressed DBO route can be refined from global block-domain interfaces to variable-local factor separators, eliminating unnecessary lambda dependence on some families while retaining proof-carrying exact SAT/#SAT/witness and source return.
novelty_firewall.calibration_role: The arbitrary-CNF embedding is a semantic and incidence-width calibration, not a P-vs-NP claim.

input_grammar.blocks: pairwise-disjoint nonempty blocks partition all surviving variables
input_grammar.Gamma: arbitrary canonical mixed-polarity foreign CNF over surviving variables
input_grammar.canonical_literal_edge_label: for each variable-clause adjacency store the exact nonempty sign-set subset of {POS,NEG}; ordinary non-tautological incidence has one sign, while a clause containing both v and NOT v may carry both signs so arbitrary CNF semantics are preserved without silently dropping tautologies
input_grammar.duplicate_literal_policy: duplicate identical literal occurrences are canonicalized to one signed occurrence with an explicit semantics-preservation receipt
input_grammar.empty_clause_policy: empty clauses are preserved as clause vertices with no variable edges and must fail at FORGET_CLAUSE

expanded_factor_graph.name: G_star

vertices.variables: one node v per surviving variable
vertices.blocks: one node B_i per DBO conjunction block
vertices.clauses: one node C_c per foreign CNF clause

edges.clause: v--C_c iff v occurs positively and/or negatively in C_c; edge label is exact canonical sign-set

expanded_factor_graph.block_partition_degree_law: every variable has exactly one BLOCK neighbor

decomposition.input: supplied tree decomposition (T,beta) of the underlying unsigned G_star

nice_decomposition.edge_rule: every graph edge is introduced exactly once before either endpoint is forgotten
nice_decomposition.join_rule: children have the same bag; processed non-bag vertex sets of the two child subtrees must be disjoint

dp_state.active_clause: clause_sat(C) in {0,1}, meaning at least one already processed incident signed literal is true
dp_state.active_block: block_alive(B) in {0,1}, meaning every already processed incident variable of B is true
dp_state.global: witness_seen in {0,1}, meaning some already forgotten complete DBO block was all true

transitions.INTRODUCE_VARIABLE: branch value(v)=0 or 1; bag-variable assignments carry unit weight until forgotten
transitions.INTRODUCE_CLAUSE_EDGE: clause_sat(C) := clause_sat(C) OR evaluation_of_exact_sign_set_label(value(v)); POS evaluates v, NEG evaluates NOT v, {POS,NEG} evaluates true
transitions.FORGET_CLAUSE: allowed only after all incident clause edges were introduced; discard state if clause_sat(C)=0, otherwise remove C
transitions.FORGET_BLOCK: allowed only after all incident block edges were introduced; witness_seen := witness_seen OR block_alive(B), then remove B
transitions.FORGET_VARIABLE: allowed only after all incident graph edges were introduced; decision projects value(v); #SAT sums the two value branches; no weight is assigned elsewhere
transitions.JOIN: active variable values must agree; clause_sat is OR; block_alive is AND; witness_seen is OR; exact counts multiply across child-private forgotten variables and sum over compatible child records
transitions.ROOT: empty root accepts iff witness_seen=1; every foreign clause must already have survived FORGET_CLAUSE

exact_counting_invariant: For each table state, the integer count equals the number of assignments to variables already forgotten in that subtree that realize exactly the recorded active-node summary. Active bag variables are unweighted. Each full surviving-variable assignment contributes exactly once at the root.

recover: one satisfied literal witness for every foreign clause
witness.source_return: invoke sealed BA20/BA21 reconstruction where the control instance belongs to that sealed route; no new BA4 carrier coverage theorem

BA24_preservation.BA24_kappa: a sufficient parameter for BA24's coarser block-domain DP
BA24_preservation.BA25_tau: separator width of a different variable-localized representation

BA23_killer_control.family: Phi_m=OR_i(a_i AND b_i), Gamma_m=AND_i(a_i OR b_i)

BA24_crosscheck: Run frozen low-kappa BA24 semantic controls through the independent BA25 formulation; SAT/#SAT/witness must agree, while state-table sizes may differ.

arbitrary_cnf_embedding.input: any CNF F over x_1,...,x_n, represented canonically with exact sign-set incidence semantics
arbitrary_cnf_embedding.Phi: z OR x_1 OR ... OR x_n
arbitrary_cnf_embedding.equivalence_target: Phi AND Gamma iff F AND z
arbitrary_cnf_embedding.count_target: #SAT(Phi AND Gamma)=#SAT(F), with unique extension z=TRUE

incidence_treewidth_calibration.H_F: ordinary variable-clause incidence graph of F, ignoring signed labels
incidence_treewidth_calibration.embedding_graph_relation: G_star contains H_F as an induced subgraph on original x_i and F-clause vertices; each singleton block {x_i} is one leaf on x_i; the fresh z component is the path {z}-z-(z)
incidence_treewidth_calibration.proof_plan: lower bound from H_F subgraph plus the fresh z edge; upper bound by adding each singleton block leaf to a bag containing x_i and using an independent width-1 decomposition for the fresh z path
incidence_treewidth_calibration.promotion_rule: promote equality only if verifier confirms all frozen edge cases; otherwise promote only the tight verified upper/lower relation and mark the equality candidate failed without rewriting preregistration

scientific_calibration_firewall.semantic_input_grammar_coverage_if_passe: arbitrary CNF embeds SAT/#SAT-preservingly into the hybrid grammar
scientific_calibration_firewall.parameterized_conclusion_if_passed: bounded expanded/incidence treewidth gives FPT processing
forbidden_inferences: arbitrary CNF has bounded incidence treewidth

falsifiers.F1: Variable-local factor graph loses DBO or clause semantics.
falsifiers.F2: State needs more than one bit per active graph node under frozen schema.
falsifiers.F4: Clause satisfaction double-counts or loses an incident literal.
falsifiers.F9: Large-block star does not have tau=1.
falsifiers.F10: BA24 kappa/lambda dependence is incorrectly called universally necessary.
falsifiers.F14: Semantic embedding is confused with BA4 carrier coverage.
falsifiers.F15: Bounded tau is promoted to unparameterized polynomial SAT.

success_meaning: For the exact hybrid DBO + foreign-CNF grammar, given a verified tree decomposition of G_star of width tau, SAT, exact #SAT, witness and proof replay are computable in poly(N,|T|)*2^O(tau), with at most 2^(tau+2) states per bag under the frozen schema; this improves BA24 parameterization on the certified large-block-star family and calibrates the grammar against arbitrary-CNF incidence width without proving unrestricted polynomial SAT.
